description: Defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration' implementing 'JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration', with nested builder class, for configuring JavaScript message mapping in Eclipse Ditto.

classes.name: ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: Immutable implementation of JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration with methods for accessing configuration properties.

classes.name: ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration.Builder
classes.description: Mutable builder class for constructing ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration instances.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the message mapper configuration.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the properties map of the configuration.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on delegationTarget.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds an immutable configuration instance from the builder.
